prior_information: September 17 morning inactivity audit and source videos are development information, not untouched evidence.
hypotheses: Narrow zones may miss repeated nearby prices. Evaluate tolerance alone without claiming the videos specify a width.
A reaction followed by continued movement may remain relevant for the same Nasdaq event. Evaluate explicit bounded persistence with invalidation.
Four votes and zero opposition may filter most opportunities. Measure alternatives separately; do not infer improvement from more signals.
A signal based on a completed hourly close may be untradeable after a large intervening move. Test a stricter entry-drift cap.

fixed.protection_policy: stop beyond event/zone; target next opposing premarked level

cost_note: Research assumptions, not observed fills or a broker fee quote. Report data/hosting separately; free current plans do not include unknown electricity costs.
benchmarks: QQQ buy-and-hold with $25 initial exposure, remainder cash
one long on first positive completed hourly candle per day, 1% stop/2% target, same $25 and costs

splits.historical: chronological 60% development / 40% validation by complete session; expanding walk-forward after first four sessions; close all simulated positions each session so labels do not cross boundaries
splits.untouched_test: Future full sessions beginning after this plan is frozen. Collect at least 40 sessions and 60 independent opportunities, with no tuning; unavailable during this task.
splits.known_contamination: Historical source-video and previously inspected market dates cannot be advertised as a final untouched test.

metrics: net dollars and return on starting capital

promotion.required: positive after-cost expectancy with multiplicity-adjusted lower confidence bound above zero; positive under higher costs and after removing best day; adjacent parameter stability; acceptable approved drawdown; full shadow and paper lifecycle evidence; explicit authorization for any live trial
promotion.critical_missing: No approved per-trade, daily, or total drawdown loss budget. No candidate is eligible for live promotion until reviewed.

proposed_risk_limits_for_review_only.note: Not approved live controls, not applied to current trader. If a setup's stop implies more risk, skip rather than silently resize. Gaps and failed protection can exceed these amounts.

selection_rule: No winner if data, independent samples, positive uncertainty bound, or execution evidence are insufficient. More trades alone never passes. Do not re-tune against validation or future test.
